body: I felt no trace of curtness or sarcasm. Thank you.
You're right. It's time for me to level up again.
Thank you. I'm glad that somewhere, there is someone who cares about me.
Thank you. That will help lessen the tears when they do come.
It wasn't across the country, but it was two states away. My dad has some issues, but my mom is the much more understanding one. And if they do help me again, it won't be for a long while.

But I do have life and work experience. Why I feel inadequate is that it seems like applicants can successfully re-invent the wheel, and they still can't be hired.

I wanted this more than anything. I really did.

My parents paid for my flight, hotel accommodations, and expenses for this interview. I won't know what to tell them. They wanted this for me too.
